authorship.method: Independent source-led labels authored before inspecting matcher outputs for this migration.

readme: PROPOSED coverage migration, not approved gold or release authority. evals/match.json remains immutable. expect:miss requires partial framing, not no candidate. Stable ids are editorial fields ignored by the current evaluator. Top-1 figure suitability is not a claim that all reader details occurred historically, nor a certification of definitive framing. Any cases with age<18 are inherited historical/synthetic fixtures, not authorization for child intake. Report inherited/new/hard/miss strata separately; aggregate improvement cannot hide old coverage losses. See case-lineage.json for all104 original cases, including33 unresolved unscored loss-of-coverage challenges. No matcher output was used to choose labels.

cases.feeling: I keep getting rejected and I don't know if I should keep trying
cases.note: known-good (smoke): creative dismissal + keep-going

cases.feeling: I escaped and don't know who I am
cases.note: known-good (smoke): escape + self-invention

cases.feeling: I just had my first child and I'm terrified I'll pass on my own father's temper
cases.note: converted: new-parent terror is angelou's territory; the 'father's temper' flavor is adjacent (her fear was youth/inadequacy, not repeating violence) - a fit the reranker judges. Age 27 vs her 16-19 window means the new_parent_fear signal must beat the soft age penalty

cases.feeling: My husband of thirty years died last spring and the silence in the house is unbearable
cases.note: converted from miss once grief was covered (lewis); age 52 sits 8y below lewis's 60-62 window, so grief signal must beat the soft age penalty

cases.feeling: my best friend and i grew apart this year, and i don't know what to do about a friendship that technically didn't end, it just faded
cases.note: friendship drift - no figure covers this; keeps miss-calibration honest (replaced the gambling miss once addiction coverage grew: wilson/coltrane)

cases.feeling: I've poured years into my work with nothing to show for it, and lately I just want to walk away and start over as someone new
cases.note: 'start over as someone new' pulls douglass's self-invention; the core is creative perseverance (butler)

cases.feeling: I escaped the people who controlled every part of my life, and now I'm alone in a new place with no idea who I am without them
cases.note: young self-invention after leaving (douglass); the only in-pool alternative at this age is butler

cases.feeling: i'm almost forty and i still have no idea what i'm supposed to do with my life
cases.note: known-good: late_start + self_doubt, midlife aimlessness

cases.feeling: the person i loved most is gone and i don't know how to believe in anything anymore
cases.note: known-good: grief + self_doubt (faith shaken), at-age

cases.feeling: i'm too scared to talk in class because i'm ashamed of how i sound when i speak
cases.note: known-good: shame + finding_voice, child age

cases.feeling: i've basically stopped talking because every time i open my mouth i'm scared they'll laugh at me
cases.note: Jones's speech-related shame/silence positive is retained. The adult Rogers testimony cannot be a same-age child-bullying confusion twin, so the old hard designation is retired, not scored as an easy hard success.

cases.feeling: i just had a baby way too young and i'm terrified i'm going to fail him
cases.note: known-good: new_parent_fear + self_doubt, teen mother

cases.feeling: i got sick with something incurable and had to move back home and leave the life i was building
cases.note: known-good: illness, forced surrender of the planned life

cases.feeling: i've worked so hard at my craft and it keeps getting rejected and i don't know if i should keep going
cases.note: Ongoing external rejection and the question of persistence favor Butler. The revised Rachmaninoff episode is a plausible creative-difficulty neighbor, but its foreground is perceived loss of ability, unfinished work and requesting time, not recurrent publisher rejection.

cases.feeling: my life looks fine on paper but i feel completely numb inside, like i'm watching it all through glass
cases.note: numbness/anhedonia - no figure covers this; keeps miss-calibration honest (replaced the betrayal miss once heartbreak coverage landed: yeats/christie)

cases.feeling: i hate my coworkers and my boss and every single day at the office feels pointless
cases.note: ordinary job dissatisfaction - no figure; keeps miss-calibration honest

cases.feeling: nobody believes me and they won't take my work seriously, but i know i'm right
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + quiet_defiance

cases.feeling: i was forced to leave my country and i lost my home, and now i'm a stranger trying to build a life somewhere that isn't mine
cases.note: known-good: exile + self_invention

cases.feeling: i can't stop drinking, it's wrecked my life, and i'm too ashamed to tell anyone
cases.note: known-good: addiction + shame

cases.feeling: i got fired in my forties and it feels far too late to start over and become someone new
cases.note: known-good: public_failure + self_invention + late_start (fired -> reinvention)

cases.feeling: i got pushed into a role i feel like a fraud in, and i'm sure i'm not smart enough, and everyone expects me to fail
cases.note: known-good: self_doubt + social_constraint (thrust into a role she feels unequal to)

cases.feeling: i lost everything at my age and i'm starting over from nothing, everyone says i'm too old
cases.note: known-good: late_start + public_failure (broke and starting over old)

cases.feeling: i wasted my best years on the wrong path and now i'm starting from scratch way too late
cases.note: midlife restart after a wrecked path (chandler) vs never-found-a-calling (child)

cases.feeling: i'm in my forties and i still have no idea what i'm meant to do with my life
cases.note: aimless, never found it (child) vs chandler's lost-then-rebuilt career

cases.feeling: i got pushed into a huge role, i feel like a fraud, and i'm sure i'm not smart enough to do it
cases.note: Graham's involuntary leadership and self-doubt positive is retained. Lee's voluntary library contribution is not a credible substitute for the old imposed-life decoy; retire hardness rather than call this an equivalent hard pair.

cases.feeling: my mom died suddenly and i'm blind, and everyone acts like i can't take care of myself
cases.note: known-good: grief + disability + self_invention (orphaned, refusing helplessness)

cases.feeling: no one came for me when it mattered, i'm so far behind everyone my age, and i don't know if i can catch up
cases.note: known-good: dispossession + worthlessness + self_invention (warehoused, starting from zero)

cases.feeling: i have nowhere to go and no family left, i've been sleeping on the streets and i feel invisible
cases.note: known-good: dispossession + solitude (homeless orphan near the music)

cases.feeling: i got told at an audition that i'm not cut out for this and should stick to my dead-end job, and part of me believes it
cases.note: Audition dismissal accompanied by a judgment about his paid work supports Poitier's recalled early audition. The user's resulting self-doubt is their feeling, not a claim about his private mental state, and trial training does not promise success.

cases.feeling: the conservatory turned me down and the dream i trained my whole life for is dead, and i'm too ashamed to face everyone who believed in me
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + shame (the refused plan a whole town paid for)

cases.feeling: i got sent away after my mom was gone, i got out, and now i sing on the streets for change, alone, with nowhere to sleep
cases.note: Orphaned homelessness and street singing favor Fitzgerald. Revised Berlin shares only young musical work and little money; his foreground is a collaborative first publication, not homelessness. The old hard designation is retired rather than counting this weakened contrast as retained adversarial coverage.

cases.feeling: the conservatory i spent my childhood preparing for rejected me and now i play piano in bars under a fake name because i'm ashamed
cases.note: the refused conservatory dream + hidden bar work (simone) vs poitier's audition dismissal

cases.feeling: people hear my accent and decide i'm not cut out for anything, i'm stuck bussing a dead-end job, and i want to prove them wrong
cases.note: Dismissal at an audition involving voice/reading and low-paid work supports Poitier; conservatory rejection and a pianist's alternative work distinguish Simone. No ninety-second timing, deficient-accent judgment or guaranteed vindication is asserted.

cases.feeling: i'm blind and i just lost my mother, and i have to figure out how to live on my own now
cases.note: Bereavement combined with blindness and independent living favors Charles. Revised Rudolph remains a disability/young-life neighbor, but concerns limited school-sport participation and trying another activity, not this loss of a parent.

cases.feeling: my teacher humiliates me in front of the class every day and calls me stupid, and i'm starting to believe him
cases.note: known-good: bullied + worthlessness (the headmaster's target, older than his class)

cases.feeling: they keep telling me to change who i am and hide where i come from, i'm not taken seriously, just some novelty to them
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + quiet_defiance + dismissed (erase-your-name pressure)

cases.feeling: i'm not allowed to study what i love because i'm a woman, my family won't let me, but i will find a way around every wall
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + quiet_defiance + self_invention (the fictitious-marriage key)

cases.feeling: my father thinks poetry is a waste of time and will only pay if i pick a practical career, but writing is who i am
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + finding_voice + self_invention (the father's deal)

cases.feeling: everyone at school makes fun of me and makes me feel stupid, and the person in charge is the cruelest one of all
cases.note: Andersen's authority-figure school humiliation positive is retained. Adult Rogers testimony cannot be the old child peer-bullying decoy, so the old hard designation is retired.

cases.feeling: i just had a baby and i'm terrified i'm too young to be anyone's mother
cases.note: Fear of being too young for a newborn favors Angelou. Revised Lindgren is a plausible young-parent neighbor about practical shared care of an older child; it does not establish secret-birth shame.

cases.feeling: every door is closed to me because i'm a woman, they won't let me study, so i will find a way around every rule
cases.note: institutional exclusion + workaround scheming (kovalevskaya) vs tallchief's identity-erasure pressure

cases.feeling: to get ahead in my field they want me to erase my heritage and take a name that isn't mine, but i won't change for them
cases.note: identity-erasure as the price of belonging (tallchief) vs kovalevskaya's barred-education constraint

cases.feeling: my family will only support a life i don't want, so i walked away from the money to find my own path and my own voice
cases.note: refusing the funded assigned life for the creative one (hughes) vs douglass's escape-into-nothing self-invention

cases.feeling: i've lost someone i love again and again, so much loss in two years, and i'm alone in a country not my own
cases.note: known-good: grief + solitude (the losses in Italy)

cases.feeling: they won't hire me because i'm a woman, and when they do they hand me the trivial stuff, but i have things to say
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + social_constraint + finding_voice (the women's-pages ghetto)

cases.feeling: i taught myself everything i know from books, but the educated people treat me like a servant and look down on me
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + dismissed + self_invention (the valet tour)

cases.feeling: i failed out of school twice and have no degree, and i'm afraid the work i do alone in my notebooks is worthless
cases.note: known-good: worthlessness + solitude (the unread notebooks)

cases.feeling: i do the hard work and the educated men take the credit, i'm not allowed in their societies, but i keep going to feed my family
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + dismissed + keep_going (the closed society)

cases.feeling: i've lost someone i love twice over, i'm widowed and alone far from home, and i have to keep going for my child
cases.note: repeated bereavement + widowhood + a child to carry (shelley_m) vs charles_r's orphaned self-reliance

cases.feeling: the men in charge keep sending me back to the trivial assignments because i'm a woman, but i have things to say and i want to say them out loud
cases.note: voice-hungry reporter shunted to the women's pages (bly) vs anning's credit-theft

cases.feeling: a man presented my discovery to the society i'm barred from and took the credit
cases.note: credit taken + institutional exclusion (anning) vs bly's assignment ghetto

cases.feeling: i keep filling notebooks, alone, with work nobody around me can even understand, and i'm starting to think it's worthless
cases.note: unjudgeable solitary work (ramanujan) vs butler's rejected-by-editors persistence

cases.feeling: i love someone who will never love me back, and i don't know what to do with all this feeling
cases.note: known-good: heartbreak + the unreturned love (first heartbreak-theme case)

cases.feeling: no school would take me because of my race and my sex, so i'll find another way in and come back with proof
cases.note: credential-hunting around a total lockout (coleman) vs bly's inside-the-door demotion

cases.feeling: they hired me and then stuck me writing fluff because i'm a woman, and i have things to say, so i'm about to walk out and prove myself somewhere bigger
cases.note: inside-the-door demotion + the walkout (bly) vs coleman's total lockout

cases.feeling: nobody believes me and they won't take my discovery seriously, but i know i'm right and i'll prove them wrong
cases.note: Marshall's rejected-discovery positive is retained. Lamarr's patent paperwork does not document dismissal of an idea; retire the old dismissed-idea confusion twin instead of counting a weakened contrast as unchanged.

cases.feeling: i lost ten years to just surviving, everyone my age is ahead of me, and i want to go back to school but it feels too late
cases.note: known-good: late_start + self_invention (sixteen again at twenty-six)

cases.feeling: an accident nearly took my sight and in the dark i realized i've been living the wrong life, i want a second chance
cases.note: known-good: illness + self_invention (the darkened room)

cases.feeling: i got seriously ill, and in the long recovery i realized the successful life i built isn't the one i actually want, i want a second chance
cases.note: illness as revelation and chosen redirect (muir) vs oconnor's forced surrender of the planned life

cases.feeling: i opened my own practice and i have no patients, i sit there all day feeling worthless and wondering if i should give up
cases.note: known-good: worthlessness + keep_going (the empty waiting room)

cases.feeling: my practice is failing, i have no patients, and when i brought the experts my one big idea they dismissed me as a nobody
cases.note: the failed nobody with one idea (banting) vs marshall's established-outsider crusade

cases.feeling: because i'm a woman they say i shouldn't even try, and my novel keeps coming back from every publisher, but i'm writing the next one
cases.note: known-good: creative_dismissal + social_constraint + keep_going (the unanimous no)

cases.feeling: my writing has been rejected by every publisher and i can't help feeling it's because i'm a woman, not because of what i wrote
cases.note: rejection entangled with identity/gender verdict (bronte_c) vs butler's pure creative perseverance

cases.feeling: i was at the top of my field and then i was publicly denounced overnight, now former friends cross the street and i'm afraid of what comes next
cases.note: known-good: public_failure + social_constraint (the denunciation)

cases.feeling: the state's paper denounced my work, my show was cancelled, and people i trusted turned on me in public meetings to save themselves
cases.note: State denunciation and public political pressure favor Shostakovich. Revised Rachmaninoff remains a composer/work-distress neighbor, but letters about unfinished composition and criticism do not establish state persecution.

cases.feeling: drinking cost me everything and i finally hit bottom, i'm too ashamed to tell the people i let down
cases.note: Wilson's drinking and shame positive is retained. Coltrane's musical-instruction episode is not an addiction-recovery decoy; retire the hard designation rather than revive unsupported history.

cases.feeling: i love someone who will never choose me, and i carry it with me everywhere, alone
cases.note: Unrequited love favors Yeats. Revised Christie is adjacent through marital separation while working, not the documented object of unreturned romantic pursuit; do not revive the retired betrayal-to-recovery arc.

cases.feeling: i gave everything to my work for years and my body finally gave out, i'm exhausted all the time and i can't do what i used to
cases.note: known-good: burnout + illness (spent, and learning to work differently)

cases.feeling: every door i knock on closes, and i'm starting to wonder if i'm meant to stop knocking
cases.note: metaphor: creative rejection + whether to persist, no literal reject/manuscript/keep-trying tokens

cases.feeling: the house has a hole in the middle of it where she used to be, and i just move around the edges
cases.note: metaphor: grief rendered spatially, no literal died/grief/loss tokens

cases.feeling: i keep promising myself that was the last time, and by morning the promise is already broken
cases.note: metaphor: the relapse cycle, no literal drinking/addiction/ashamed tokens

cases.feeling: My coworker and I put out our first song. It is actually out there now, but after splitting the money there was barely enough for a coffee.
cases.note: A first collaborative publication with a very small return supports the comparison; neither a hit nor self-sufficiency is promised.

cases.feeling: I tried making a song with the person I work with after hearing what the other performers were doing. We both got credit, but selling it brought in almost nothing.
cases.note: The comparison concerns credited collaboration and modest earnings, not an unpublished/repeatedly rejected manuscript.

cases.feeling: I finally got into college, but the jobs I do between classes still leave me skipping meals. Telling people how short I am is the hardest part.
cases.note: Studying while doing subsistence work, food shortage and reluctance to disclose need are documented; eventual community support is not a guarantee to the reader.

cases.feeling: It is not getting accepted that is stopping me now. I am enrolled and working, but I cannot stretch the money to both school and enough food.
cases.note: Present-tense subsistence after admission distinguishes this from Hurston's return-to-school/late-start foreground.

cases.feeling: Since my marriage split up I have been writing to pay the bills, with my child needing me in the middle of it. The book got done and I still cannot stand it.
cases.note: Separation, childcare interruptions, financial need and a completed but disliked book all belong to the replacement episode.

cases.feeling: I delivered the novel I needed to sell while my home life was coming apart. Everyone assumes finishing means I feel better about it, but I do not.
cases.note: Completed but disliked paid work during separation differs from Rachmaninoff's unfinished composition/request for time.

cases.feeling: I can play gigs, but this new piece defeats me every time. I need the other musician to slow it down, write it out and show me again.
cases.note: An experienced player learns through repeated passages, written notes and demonstrations; this is not addiction recovery.

cases.feeling: Being able to perform does not mean I understand everything. I keep going back to another player with questions, and when they stop playing I still need the rest of the band.
cases.note: Repeated instruction and reliance on collaborators distinguish practical musical learning from Rachmaninoff's stated loss of composing ability.

cases.feeling: I thought the application was finished, then they said the signature did not match the name on the original form. Now another document has to arrive before the deadline.
cases.note: A name/signature mismatch and deadline in an application support an administrative-work comparison, not appearance-based dismissal.

cases.feeling: The fee is paid and the paperwork is going through, but one name on the form is holding everything up. The idea is not being debated; I have to correct the document.
cases.note: Administrative correction is the decisive detail. This is an ordinary diagnostic positive; Marshall's scientific resistance is a different problem, not a sufficiently close hard confusion twin.

cases.feeling: I have gathered a useful little library for the community. The larger project is nowhere near finished, and I want to offer what is ready without pretending it is the whole thing.
cases.note: Offering an existing contribution while explicitly describing a larger undertaking as gradual is the supported action.

cases.feeling: There is something concrete I can give people now, even though the institution I hope it becomes will take years. I am trying to call it a beginning honestly.
cases.note: This is an unfinished institutional contribution, not McClintock's qualification of an evidential scientific comparison.

cases.feeling: People keep saying how impressive my art is for someone from my background. I want them to tell me where the sculpture is wrong so I can learn.
cases.note: The source reports a request for criticism instead of identity-based praise, not proof of an eventual visit or revised work.

cases.feeling: I am showing someone my first sculpture and asking for real faults, not a pat on the head about who made it. Kind encouragement is not the same as useful feedback.
cases.note: Requesting technical criticism differs from Tallchief's pressure to change a name/erase heritage. Neither identity requires alteration.

cases.feeling: My little boy has come to stay with me, but I cannot keep my job and look after him on my own. My parents can take care of him for a while.
cases.note: The documented practical care conflict and grandparents' help support this comparison; guilt and abandonment are not asserted.

cases.feeling: My child has already had to leave one home. I want him with me, but working and caring for him is not sustainable, so I am accepting help from family.
cases.note: A disrupted established care arrangement and sharing care distinguish this from Angelou's fear of handling a newborn.

cases.feeling: I can see a possible link between results in two different systems, but I want to publish it with the limits clear. I do not have the evidence to call it a general rule.
cases.note: A proposed cross-system relationship with explicit evidential qualification is supported; no private crisis or rejected-genius vindication is implied.

cases.feeling: The comparison in my research seems worth putting out there. I need to say what has not been confirmed instead of selling it as the final answer.
cases.note: Publishing a tentative scientific comparison differs from Lee offering a tangible early part of a larger institutional project.

cases.feeling: Winning brought invitations everywhere, but the appearances wore us out and the expenses were not turning up. Now my eligibility is suspended and I still need paid work.
cases.note: Recognition, reported exhibition complaints, suspension and uncertain income are supported without asserting one proven complaint-to-suspension causal sequence.

cases.feeling: People recognize me for what I won, but that does not pay for everyday life. The business I tried afterward went into debt, and I still need reliable earnings.
cases.note: Public athletic recognition alongside insecure income and business debt differs from Banting's empty new medical practice.

cases.feeling: I practiced for another audition and was turned away again. I am asking if I can clean the place in exchange for a chance to sit in on lessons.
cases.note: Unsuccessful auditions, practice and a cleaning-for-classes request are supported. The reader age does not assert a recovered exact audition date.

cases.feeling: They are letting me attend on a trial basis, but some of the teachers still think I should not stay. Getting through the door has not made my place secure.
cases.note: Insecure trial admission after auditions differs from Lewis seeking useful criticism of work after finding a sympathetic adviser.

cases.feeling: I have written so little that I wonder if I can compose anymore. I want to ask for longer with this unfinished work, but I cannot promise that I will manage it.
cases.note: The letters document this stated loss of ability and a bounded request for time, not a treatment/cure story.

cases.feeling: I had to pull out because the piece was not finished. People encourage me, but there are still interruptions and I still doubt what I am sending them.
cases.note: Unfinished work, missed commitments and continuing criticism/doubt distinguish this from Coltrane's practical instruction while already performing.

cases.feeling: I have to explain to the people holding the budget why giving children time for ordinary feelings matters. I can describe what we actually do, but I cannot decide the funding.
cases.note: The testimony explains ordinary emotional material and the work behind children's television; a favorable hearing is not a final appropriation.

cases.feeling: Our work with children is quiet, so I am bringing examples to the decision-maker. I do several jobs to make it happen, and I need to make the value understandable.
cases.note: An established practitioner explains caring work. This is an ordinary diagnostic positive: Graham being thrust into leadership is not a sufficiently close hard confusion twin. No stage fright is attributed to Rogers.

cases.feeling: I made the team but spent most of the season watching. Someone has invited me to try a different sport; I can give it a go without knowing if it is my thing.
cases.note: Limited playing time and trying another sport support a partial life-stage connection. Adult input18 is beyond the qualified historical5–16 envelope, not proof the episode happened at18.

cases.feeling: Being picked did not mean I got to play much. I am considering another activity to stay involved, even though the original sport is still the one I care about.
cases.note: Limited sports participation followed by another activity differs from Poitier's audition-to-trial-class access. Adult input19 is a partial connection beyond the coarse historical envelope, never an age-identical or cure claim.

cases.feeling: I have helped plan a gathering with several organizations, and they are still arguing about what to say. Before anyone arrives I keep wondering whether people will actually come.
cases.note: Coalition disagreement and a colleague's recalled turnout question support the comparison, not universal erasure or abandonment.

cases.feeling: The event drew people, but the groups still disagree and we have not worked out what to do afterward. One big day did not finish the shared work.
cases.note: Collective follow-through after a gathering differs from Rogers explaining an existing program to one funding decision-maker.

cases.feeling: After years working in fashion I could not find the kind of dress I wanted. I am thinking about a shop of my own using what I have learned, not throwing my experience away.
cases.note: A market gap discovered through a personal dress search and a business using prior experience are the documented foreground.

cases.feeling: I have spent years learning this trade for other people. Now I see clothes customers might want that nobody seems to offer, and I want to build my own business around that.
cases.note: An experienced move into a self-directed business differs from Child finding a first absorbing vocation. It is not a start without skills, support or resources.

cases.feeling: My partner and I love each other, but we keep arguing about who cleans and cooks. It is the daily unfairness, not a breakup or a big career problem.
cases.note: The proposed catalog has separation, bereavement, parenting and vocational stories, but no foreground about negotiating routine household labor in an intact partnership. An adjacent fragment is possible; definitive episode equivalence is not supported.

cases.feeling: My roommate keeps borrowing my things without asking. I want to set a boundary without turning our flat into a fight.
cases.note: None of the proposed fifty foregrounds concerns roommate property boundaries. Dispossession, institutional exclusion and violent control must not be substituted for this ordinary conflict. A partial fragment is allowed.

cases.feeling: My friends still answer when I message them, but they make plans without me now. I cannot tell if our group is just changing or if I should say something.
cases.note: Adult friendship-group drift/exclusion has no close foreground here. It is not imposed exile, bereavement, school authority abuse or a childhood Rogers episode. Partial framing is the required calibration, not rejection of the reader.

cases.feeling: My sibling and I keep disagreeing about who will look after our elderly parent. Neither of us wants to abandon them, but we cannot agree on the practical arrangement.
cases.note: No age-eligible foreground documents siblings negotiating care of an elderly parent. Lindgren is about a young mother's childcare, far outside this age range; illness in the reader is not the same problem. A partial analogy remains allowed.
